result.report:
The supplied argument establishes the stated partial universal characterization, with two harmless wording corrections below. It does not establish the original arbitrary balanced-pair classification.

The dependency chain is self-contained. I checked the elementary cone-generation, pointed-polyhedron decomposition, elimination, separation, rational convex-completion, supergradient and normal-cone arguments. The authentic [BMPS v1 PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.08664v1), dated March 10, 2026, confirms the cited conventions. Its integral-slope restriction is correctly distinguished from the explicitly declared real scalar extension. No cited source theorem, predecessor verdict, compilation or diagnostic supplies an essential premise.

The intersection reconstruction retains saturated lattices. In a two-cone, the representative s/χ gives the primitive quotient class modulo the tangent ray; the tangential discrepancy cancels in the divisor formula. The three refinement cases preserve coefficients and balancing. Equation (6) proves first-divisor balancing by cancellation of the symmetric cone contributions. Commutativity also follows directly: the mixed second coefficient is the sum over cones of (ω/χ)(h(s)k(r)+h(r)k(s)), minus the sum over rays of t_r h(r)k(r). This is symmetric in h and k. Locality, affine annihilation, real bilinearity and the unnormalized two-stage measure follow from the same formulas. The plane check gives eight, retaining the 2! normalization.

The PC-to-PAPC proof covers arbitrary ordinary opens and every possible positive cycle dimension, namely one and two. Rational balanced incident vectors produce rational endpoints after the common tangential correction. The rational cone-generation argument then extends positivity to every nonnegative real balanced incident vector. Product top-cycle balancing uses the actual primitive factor directions; arbitrary rational refinements inherit it.

The graph reductions are valid. Strict positivity of the prescribed relation forces the entire direction kernel to be one-dimensional. Primitive integer relations therefore exist, and weight ratios propagate rationally through every connected component, including cycles. Bivalent vertices are straight with equal weights; every unbranched component is a complete rational affine line. Thus the cylinder reduction applies precisely when one original graph is unbranched. The coface argument also checks arbitrary structures and remote endpoints, rather than only a chosen product subdivision.

For the positive direction, partial infima preserve rational graph PCCs. Finiteness propagates across edges and junctions, so a supporting slope of a rational vertical slice gives a globally finite scalar competitor. The recession constraints defining D exactly control the fibre infima; positive growth makes zero interior, and complete vertical fibres make D compact. Fibre vertices yield the finite affine minima, while the tail slopes retain mixed recession behaviour. Chord and tail replacements increase outgoing derivatives and stay below the concave scalar obstacles. The incidence system includes all cycle edges and has a greatest feasible assignment. Elimination gives concave PA node values with rational gradients.

These facts establish the whole envelope: Q is actual PC and below f; every raw competitor is bounded by Q first at rational points through touching vertical supports, then at every real point through arbitrarily small rational enclosing simplices. No continuity of raw competitors is assumed. The bounds γ−C≤Q≤f≤γ+C establish two-sided growth, and bounded difference implies equality of recession slopes on common affine cells.

The rational-domain step is substantive and valid. Supergradient intervals have rational endpoints, and the normal cones have rational generators even when the slope-chamber endpoints are real. Equations (21)–(22) consequently give finite rational maximization domains. Their vertices lie over graph nodes, excluding omitted atoms in open strips or distant tails.

Complete contact follows at every possible atom. A singleton exposed slope interval gives zero second divisor. For a nondegenerate interval, a strict obstacle gap forces strict scalar caps, hence vanishing node Laplacian by greatest-assignment maximality. Positive weighted concavity then forces all outgoing slope functions to be affine on that interval. The sole relation allows their coefficients to factor through ambient linear forms, with the transverse form rational. The resulting germ is ambient affine plus a one-variable kink. Its first divisor is supported where the residual vanishes, so every term of its second divisor is zero. This includes junction fibres and all intermediate lower faces. Finite components and actual product scales preserve the conclusion. The explicit P+1/n sequence verifies uniform decreasing regularizability; all outputs already lie in the reconstructed PA operator domain.

For the negative direction, the rational tripod maps annihilate exactly the actual relation kernels without replacing any lattice or cycle. The ambient convex reference is globally actual PC and has strictly positive recession slopes. The endpoint combination (30) is a genuine PCC with total coefficient one, centre (A,B), and zero obstacle values. It forces the central vertex bound. All other reference vertices have zero obstacle. The pointed-cell decomposition and rational far-endpoint PCCs then prove P=γ globally using only upper growth, covering bounded edges, cycles, ends and components.

The junction recursion is complete: the primitive kink ray and both saturated indices in (33)–(34) give (35); the axis tangential corrections give (37). Kink rays contribute zero to the second divisor, while each factor-axis family contributes 4ab. Thus the central coefficient is 8ab. Every other reference vertex has zero gap, and obstacle-refinement vertices have zero inherited second coefficient. The entire integral is therefore −8ab, with an actual PAPC and regularizable envelope and no boundary term at infinity.

The supplementary failed-roof calculation also checks: its genuine PCC has endpoint mean 11/12 against centre value one, so the coarse roof is not PC.

Harmless wording corrections: ‘ρ<r₀ is precisely the product of short stars’ should mean the intersection of the local product star with that neighbourhood. In the recession estimate, ρ(r) denotes the homogeneous norm ||r₁||₁+||r₂||₁, rather than evaluating the translated point-distance function at r. Neither correction changes the argument.
